state.title: naoqi_get_state
naoqi_stand

part.text: The robot is standing and the corridor is clear ahead, with walls about 2.5 m away on both sides. I'll walk straight forward.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: The view ahead shows a wall fairly close, and no green panel yet. I'll check both sides before going further.

state.title: naoqi_look_around

part.text: Nothing green is visible yet. The far wall is about 1.9 m ahead and the corridor appears to bend left past it. I'll advance about 1.2 m and look again.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: A wall is now about 0.93 m ahead. I'll look left and right to find where the corridor continues.

state.title: naoqi_look_around

part.text: The green panel is visible down the corridor to the left. I'll turn left to face that passage.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: The green panel is now straight ahead. I'll walk forward about 1.5 m and check the distance.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: The panel looks closer but is still some distance away. I'll take a shorter step of about 0.6 m.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: The panel has moved to the left edge of the view, so it's off to my left. I'll look left to pin down its position.

state.title: naoqi_look_around

part.text: The panel sits roughly straight ahead, slightly to my left. I'll make a short 0.3 m forward step, which will stop if something blocks it.

state.title: naoqi_walk_to

part.text: The panel is now on the left side of my view, so I need to move a little left as well as forward. I'll make a small diagonal step.

state.title: naoqi_walk_to

part.text: The panel now appears to be on the wall to my left, about 1.6 m away. I'll turn left to face it.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: I'm now facing a wall at close range, and the panel is no longer in view. I'll sweep the head to find it.

state.title: naoqi_look_around

part.text: The panel is now visible about 46° to my right. I'll turn toward it and advance a short distance.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: The panel is now close, on my right. I'll look right to judge its position before stepping in.

state.title: naoqi_look_around

part.text: The panel is on the wall ahead-right. I'll turn toward it and advance about 0.5 m.

state.title: naoqi_go

part.text: The green panel now fills my view straight ahead, so I'm very close. I'll take one small final step of 0.2 m. The move stops on its own if something blocks it.

state.title: naoqi_walk_to

part.text: The green panel fills the view directly ahead and I'm in front of it, so I'll stop here and turn the motors off.

state.title: naoqi_rest

part.text:
The robot reached the green panel and is resting in front of it. The corridor bent twice (left, then right), so the route wasn't a straight run. The robot is now in a crouch with its motors off.

Its final position is about 3.4 m forward and 3.8 m to the side of the start, based on odometry. The panel fills the camera view, and the side walls read about 0.5 to 0.6 m away, so it is close, though I didn't measure the exact distance to the panel.
